              HOW TO PLAY

              X-BOMB PAROL FIESTA
              Light Up Your Christmas Luck!

              🎁 1. Santa’s Daily Gift — Check In & Win!

              Check in every day to collect Christmas rewards!

              • Day 1–2: Claim your daily reward.
              • Day 3 onwards: Get Points and 1 Christmas Surprise Chest for every day you continue checking in.
              • Surprise Chest: Open it to get a random reward such as Points, Instant Cash, Free Spins, or Golden Draw Tickets.

              Reminder: If you miss a day, your check-in will start again from Day 1.

              🌟 2. Parol Quest — Earn Sparks & Get Rewards!

              Complete missions to earn Sparks and unlock rewards!

              🎄 Christmas Mission
              • Place bets on eligible games to earn Sparks.
              • Collect enough Sparks to unlock Parols.
              • Your unlocked Parols will be added to your account automatically.
              • Your mission progress updates about every 30 minutes.

              Note: Deposits are not counted in the Christmas Mission.

              🎯 Daily Mission
              • Complete daily betting or deposit tasks to earn Sparks.
              • Reach the required Sparks to unlock Cash Bonuses, Parols, or both.
              • Tap Claim to collect your rewards.

              Reminder: Claim your rewards on the same day or before 11:59 PM the next day. Unclaimed rewards will expire.

              ⚡ How to Earn Sparks
              ActivitySparks Earned
              ₱1 bet on Slots1 Spark
              ₱1 bet on Live Casino0.5 Spark
              ₱1 bet on Perya1 Spark
              ₱1 bet on Sports2 Sparks
              ₱1 successful deposit1 Spark

              IMPORTANT NOTE: Only eligible bets and successful deposits count. Deposit Sparks are for Daily Missions only.

              🏮 3. Parol Wish Draw — Use Your Parols!

              Use your collected Parols to join the Christmas prize draws!

              1. Go to Parol Wish Draw.
              2. Choose from 4 prize pools.
              3. Check the prizes and how many Parols you need.
              4. Confirm your draw and reveal your reward.

              📅 Important Dates

              • Last day to earn Sparks, collect Parols, and complete missions.
              • You can still use your remaining Parols for the Wish Draw.
              • Last chance to use your Parols. Unused Parols will expire.

              All dates and times follow Philippine Time (UTC+8).
